title: Delhi NCR's air turns 'severe' as pollution readings pass 450 and primary schools move online
summary: Thick smog has covered Delhi NCR since Monday morning. Air-quality readings passed 450, the 'severe' level, and the city's emergency pollution rules are in force.

title: Delhi schools shut as smog worsens
summary: Delhi's primary schools close their classrooms for the week as the smog thickens.

title: India beat Australia by four wickets in the second ODI at the Wankhede to level the series
summary: Australia made 288 for 7 after choosing to bat. India reached 289 for 6 with 11 balls to spare, levelling the three-match series at 1-1.

title: A Bengaluru start-up's open AI model tops a global coding leaderboard, ahead of rival labs with far more money and staff
summary: A small Bengaluru team's openly published model came first in a widely followed ranking of AI coding tools, which compares models on real programming tasks.

title: Bitcoin climbs back above $100,000 after a week of sharp swings
summary: Bitcoin fell to about $93,000 on Wednesday, then recovered over the weekend. It crossed $100,000 again late on Sunday, India time.
